meta.title: AnyPick — AI Account Switcher for Claude Code & Codex
meta.description: Switch Claude Code, Codex and other AI coding accounts without editing config files. Free, open-source desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux. Download AnyPick.

workflow.title: One account for work. Another for this repo.
workflow.body: Keep work and personal logins separate. Give a repo its own account. Try an API gateway for one run. Choose how far each switch should reach.
workflow.saveBody: Add an existing provider login or an API gateway in Accounts & APIs.
workflow.toolBody: Pick a compatible saved source in Apps, then review the change plan.
workflow.applyBody: Apply the change and use your coding tool. Restore its saved settings with anypick reset.

safety.kicker: Safe to change. Easy to undo.
safety.title: Your settings stay yours.
safety.reviewBody: The desktop app shows the account, model, proxy, and client-config steps in a route plan.
safety.configTitle: Keep the rest of your config
safety.configBody: AnyPick tracks the settings it manages and asks before taking over settings it did not write.
safety.restoreBody: Use anypick reset to restore the saved state for an app. Credentials stay in your local AnyPick data directory.
safety.accountAlt: AnyPick Accounts & APIs listing saved provider logins and an API gateway. Names and account details are demo data.

compatibility.title: Supported tools, with provider rules intact.
compatibility.body: AnyPick only offers routes supported by both sides of the connection. It does not treat every account as interchangeable.
compatibility.claudeRule: Claude logins stay in Claude Code. Gemini CLI and Kiro use their own provider accounts.
compatibility.otherRule: Other compatible tools can use selected external accounts or API gateways.

faq.title: Before you switch.
faq.freeA: Yes. AnyPick is free and open source under the MIT license. You use your own provider accounts or API keys; their subscription and usage charges still apply.
faq.accountsQ: Which accounts can I use with each coding tool?
faq.accountsA: Available routes depend on the client and account adapter. Claude logins stay in Claude Code; Gemini CLI and Kiro use their own provider accounts. The {{accountsALink}} lists the supported combinations.
faq.relayQ: Does AnyPick send prompts through its servers?
faq.relayA: No. AnyPick has no hosted relay. When two tools need different API protocols, the local Go service runs the translator on loopback and sends requests to the provider you selected.
faq.credentialsA: AnyPick stores account data locally in ~/.anypick. Backups contain working credentials in readable JSON, so keep them private.
faq.macQ: Why does macOS warn when opening the app?
faq.macA: The app is not notarized yet. Open it with right-click → Open, or use System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway. The CLI is available separately.
